DAILY SITE REPORT - Riverside Commercial Building
Report date: 2026-11-04
Weather: Dry, 29 C. Workforce: 24 operatives.
The consultant instructed us to relocate the ground-floor service trench outside the original scope.
Additional excavation was required along grid B4, estimated cost USD 1,250.50 and delay of 2 days.
Concrete delivery rejected after the slump test at the site gate.
A clash between the drainage route and foundation beam was identified on drawing S-104 revision C.
No delay to roof works was reported.
Routine reinforcement inspection completed and photographs filed.
